results.label: Osilodrostat (LCI699)

source.title: IsoFit selectivity results and team handoff
source.scope: Accepted relaxed ligand-water exchange energies as reported by the team. Underlying pose bundles and convergence logs were not supplied with this handoff.

calibration.fit_method: One shared coefficient, least squares in log10 potency-concentration ratios; poses and assay selected retrospectively.
calibration.ratio_definition: S = potency concentration B1 / potency concentration B2; S > 1 favors B2. IC50 and Ki remain distinct endpoints.

limitations: Training fits, not independent predictions: both known targets and a search of 360 pose/assay combinations informed this calibration.
Selected poses are post hoc choices, not each compound's lowest-energy pair. Original minima and weighted deltas are retained.
The coefficient is empirical, not a physical constant or a transferable calibration; do not apply it to the frozen fadrozole workflow or arbitrary proteins.
Weighted results use the reported 310 K and 0.25 angstrom all-heavy-atom clustering; both are unresolved under the team's pose-spread rule.
UMA is fitted and Boltz is uncalibrated. This is not a fair model accuracy comparison; two seeds are not confidence intervals.
Solvent, entropy, chemical-state assumptions and sparse sampling remain unvalidated. Paired assays and held-out compounds are required.
The handoff ends at a Sources heading without bibliographic entries. O01/O02/B01/M01 are supplied identifiers, not independently verified citations.

quality.reason: One B1 nonconvergence. Team pose-spread rule marks the weighted result unresolved.

other_assays.role: Original primary pilot reference; human V79

scenes.name: 01-intro
scenes.title: From eV to fold preference.
scenes.caption: A real analysis workflow using the team’s supplied UMA outputs.

scenes.name: 02-inputs
scenes.title: 01 / Choose a molecule and trace its energy inputs.
scenes.caption: Osilodrostat · B2 target / B1 counter-screen · Team-selected poses
scenes.badge: Supplied UMA energies / No new inference

scenes.name: 03-structures
scenes.title: 02 / Inspect the protein reference pockets.
scenes.caption: Experimental reference coordinates—not the selected relaxed drug poses.

scenes.name: 04-calculate
scenes.title: 03 / Recompute the exchange. Apply the fitted conversion.
scenes.caption: X = E(cluster + ligand) + E(water) − E(cluster + water) − E(ligand)
scenes.badge: Real backend calculation / No new UMA run

scenes.name: 05-energy
scenes.title: Four energy terms per enzyme. One matched difference.
scenes.caption: Osilodrostat: X(B1) − X(B2) = +0.238037 eV. Positive favors B2 in this model.

scenes.name: 06-osilodrostat
scenes.title: 3.23× fitted B2 preference. Below the 10× screen.
scenes.caption: O01 experimental IC50 ratio: 3.57×. This was a training target, not a held-out validation.

scenes.name: 07-baxdrostat
scenes.title: 103.36× fitted B2 preference. A stronger fitted signal.
scenes.caption: B01 experimental Ki ratio: 100.77×. The same fitted coefficient is used for both compounds.

scenes.name: 08-crosscheck
scenes.title: 04 / Compare models—and keep their provenance visible.
scenes.caption: Boltz seeds: 1.87× / 1.69×. Uncalibrated Boltz vs fitted UMA is not an accuracy ranking.
scenes.badge: Cross-check / Ki remains distinct from IC50

scenes.name: 09-sensitivity
scenes.title: Pose choice matters: 103.36× becomes 5.86×.
scenes.caption: Original baxdrostat minima, same coefficient. The fitted screen flips; pose robustness stays unresolved.

scenes.name: 10-quality-gate
scenes.title: Missing convergence? Stop before reporting a fold.
scenes.caption: Metyrapone: zero accepted B2 starts. No ratio invented.

scenes.name: 11-outro
scenes.title: Understand the signal. Design the next experiment.
scenes.caption: IsoForm · Traceable energies, explicit assumptions, testable next steps.
